description: Queue one manual run using the tracker’s saved tool inputs. A repeated requestToken returns the same logical run. Tracker management and stored-report reads are free. Each scheduled or manual run bills one call per prompt at the normal per-model rates; the activation response and tracker record expose the accepted maximum cost per run. Present the returned USD amounts to users; activation still takes the exact estimatedCostMicroPerRun integer returned by the tracker.

requestToken.description: Stable caller-generated token used to deduplicate a retried manual run.

trackerId.description: Cite42 tracker ID returned by a tracker management or report tool.

name: cite42_tracker_run
